title: Kyoto: Temples & Tea Culture
summary: Ten unhurried nights in the old capital — machiya guesthouses, a private tea ceremony, and mornings built around temples before the crowds arrive.
highlights: Dawn walk through the Fushimi Inari gates
Private tea ceremony with a third-generation host
A day trip into the Kitayama mountains, onsen included
Nishiki Market food crawl with a local guide

itinerary.title: Arrive & settle in
itinerary.description: Private transfer into the city and two unplanned days in your machiya guesthouse's neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Fushimi Inari at dawn
itinerary.description: A guided walk through the gates before they belong to anyone else.

itinerary.title: Tea ceremony & Gion
itinerary.description: An afternoon tea ceremony, then a quiet walk through the old geisha district into a kaiseki dinner.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama
itinerary.description: The bamboo grove early, then a slow boat down the Hozugawa river.

itinerary.title: Nishiki Market
itinerary.description: A stall-by-stall food crawl with a guide who knows which queues are worth it.

itinerary.title: Kitayama mountains
itinerary.description: A two-night trip north into the hills, ending each day in a private hot-spring bath.

itinerary.title: Kiyomizu-dera & pottery quarter
itinerary.description: The wooden temple stage, then an afternoon browsing working potters' studios.

itinerary.title: Depart Kyoto
itinerary.description: A final quiet morning before your private transfer to the airport.

included: 9 nights in hand-picked machiya guesthouses & a mountain ryokan
Daily breakfast, 4 dinners including one kaiseki
All guided experiences listed in the itinerary
A dedicated trip consultant, reachable throughout
